data.one_liner: An Android plugin to download single or multiple files to public downloads or app directories.
data.what_it_does: Downloads files directly to Android's public downloads or app-specific storage with progress notifications and callbacks. Supports bulk downloads, parallel execution limits, cancellation, and custom headers. It handles Android 10+ storage restrictions without requiring complex native configuration.
use_when: You need to download files into Android's public Downloads directory or app directory with progress tracking.
You want built-in support for system download notifications and parallel/sequential bulk downloading on Android.
avoid_when: You need iOS, web, or desktop support (this package only supports Android).
You only need local file path access rather than downloading files over HTTP/HTTPS.
strengths: Supports parallel and batch downloads with configurable limits.
Provides download cancellation and progress callbacks.
Handles Android-specific storage and notification permissions conveniently.
weaknesses: Android-only; does not work on iOS, web, or desktop platforms.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding INTERNET and WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permissions in AndroidManifest.xml (and DOWNLOAD_WITHOUT_NOTIFICATION if disabling notifications).
